Subject: Hosted API evaluation — short demo request

Hi Jonas,

I signed up for the Hosted API evaluation earlier today (we're excited to try the sandbox). Would you be available for a quick 30-minute walkthrough of the Hosted API and the sandbox flow? We're a PLG lead at BrightCart and mostly interested in:
- how token pricing maps to per-request cost at scale
- telemetry / observability (latency/cost per route)
- security: data retention and SOC 2 questions

Our team is in PDT. Availability windows that work for us:
- Tue Nov 9 between 10:00–13:00 PT
- Wed Nov 10 morning (9:00–11:30 PT)

If you have a standard agenda or anything you'd like us to share beforehand, let us know.

Thanks,

Head of AI Integrations
BrightCart
emma@brightcart.com

Hi Emma — great to meet you and welcome to the sandbox.

I can run a focused 30-minute walkthrough that covers the Hosted API flow, a quick performance/cost primer, and next steps for a short pilot. Monica (solutions engineer) is cc'd to join the call for the technical section.

Here is a quick availability grid in PT:
- Tue Nov 9: 10:30, 11:00, 15:00
- Wed Nov 10: 09:30, 10:00

A couple of asks to make the session higher value:
1) Could you share a representative prompt or SLA goals (qps / concurrent requests)?
2) Any specific compliance artifacts you want us to be prepared to discuss (SOC 2 scope, data residency)?
3) If there are internal users that need access to the sandbox, list emails and preferred roles.

I've attached a short prep checklist (HostedAPI-demo-prep-checklist.pdf) — two pages, quick fields to fill in. I'll send a calendar invite once we lock a time.

If none of these slots work, tell me a preferred window and we can expand.

Thanks,

jonas@redwoodinference.com
